summary: Shops have display windows with stock behind the glass; house walls carry grime under the eaves, damp at the foot and gutter runs.
stage: tests/fixtures/environment-views.gd --capture-set=town (shopfront-kerb and house-kerb, eye-level views added for this) and tools/showcase/building-surfaces.tscn --building-kinds=shops; parent-revision comparison
rationale: A look change seen best at a man's eye: matched stills of a shop and a sunlit rendered wall from the street, and the studio's shop parade, side by side with the revision before.
before_ref: git archive of b054bb01 into a scratch copy, rendered with the same fixtures and flags (the new eye-level views copied into it).

capture.renderer: Godot 4.7.2 Forward+, High preset, 1600x900, day; Compatibility renderer checked on both eye-level views
capture.comparison: Captures reduced to 800x450 panels (the wall and the studio parade cropped to 1280x720 first), before left and after right.

validation: building-components, structure-batches and determinism tests pass
limitations: The glass is the town's opaque glass, so the stock shows where a pane is out; the studio's before parade has house windows where the after has display windows, as the town builds them.
